title: Multi-Writer Head Writes
summary: Reserved scenario slot for conflict-aware ref advance and multi-writer head semantics as that work stabilizes.
whySQLiteFallsShort: SQLite does not ship with Git-like concurrent head-management semantics, so this showcase slot is reserved until SydraDB's multi-writer story is ready to demonstrate honestly.
Keeping the slot visible but gated makes the roadmap explicit without pretending the feature is already stable.
The showcase can absorb the feature later through a new scenario pack instead of a UI rewrite.
